title: Moving day in Littleroot
tagline: The player arrives in the back of a moving truck
description: The game opens inside the moving truck. Mom welcomes the player to Littleroot Town, Vigoroth movers unpack the house, the player sets the wall clock upstairs and watches Dad (Norman, Petalburg Gym Leader) on TV.
lore: Establishes the family: Dad has just become a Gym Leader in Petalburg, which is why the family moved to Hoenn. The clock-setting step is the in-game RTC setup.

title: Meeting the Birch family
tagline: Next door lives Prof. Birch's child, the rival
description: The player visits the house next door, meets the rival's mother and goes upstairs to meet the rival (May or Brendan, the opposite of the player's choice), who is out helping Prof. Birch with field research.
lore: The rival is the Professor's child and a fellow new Trainer; their friendly rivalry runs through the whole game.

title: Rescuing Prof. Birch
tagline: A wild Pokémon chases the Professor on Route 101
description: On Route 101 the player finds Prof. Birch being chased by a wild Zigzagoon. Grabbing a Poké Ball from his bag, the player chooses Treecko, Torchic or Mudkip and wins the first battle. Birch lets the player keep the Pokémon.
lore: Starter choice is stored in VAR_STARTER_MON and decides the rival's team for every later battle (trainer variants *-treecko / *-torchic / *-mudkip).

title: First rival battle and the Pokédex
tagline: The rival tests the player on Route 103 and Birch hands over the Pokédex
description: Birch sends the player to find the rival on Route 103. After their first battle, Birch gives the player a Pokédex (the rival gives Poké Balls) and asks them to fill it. Mom gives the Running Shoes; the adventure officially starts.
lore: First structured trainer battle; teaches catching and the Pokédex goal.

title: Helping Wally catch a Pokémon
tagline: Dad asks the player to help a sickly boy catch his first Pokémon
description: At Petalburg Gym the player meets Dad and a frail boy, Wally, who is moving to Verdanturf for the cleaner air. Dad lends Wally a Zigzagoon and the player escorts him to Route 102, where he catches a Ralts. Dad says to return with four badges for a Gym battle.
lore: Wally's growth from a sick boy into a strong Trainer is a parallel arc that pays off at Mauville and Victory Road.

title: Team Aqua in Petalburg Woods
tagline: First sighting of Team Aqua
description: In Petalburg Woods a Team Aqua Grunt tries to rob a Devon Corporation researcher of his papers; the player defeats the grunt and the researcher gives a Great Ball.
lore: Introduces Team Aqua and Devon Corp.'s research as the villains' target.

title: Roxanne and the Stone Badge
tagline: First Gym: Rustboro City (Rock)
description: The player defeats Rustboro Gym Leader Roxanne, a Rock-type specialist who studies at the Pokémon Trainer's School, earning the Stone Badge and TM39 Rock Tomb.
lore: Stone Badge lets Pokémon use Cut outside battle. Rustboro is home to Devon Corporation.

title: The stolen Devon Goods
tagline: A Team Aqua grunt robs Devon and kidnaps Mr. Briney's Wingull
description: A Team Aqua Grunt steals Devon Goods and flees east through Route 116 into Rusturf Tunnel, taking Peeko, Mr. Briney's Wingull, as a hostage. The player beats the grunt, returns Peeko and recovers the goods.
lore: Sets up Mr. Briney as the player's boatman: he owes the player for saving Peeko.

title: Errands for Devon's president
tagline: Mr. Stone gives the PokéNav and two deliveries
description: Devon President Mr. Stone thanks the player with a PokéNav and asks for two favours: deliver a Letter to his son Steven in Dewford, and deliver the Devon Goods to Capt. Stern in Slateport. The rival is battled outside (Rustboro).
lore: Mr. Stone's errands drive the next two chapters and introduce Steven Stone.

title: Sailing with Mr. Briney
tagline: The old sailor ferries the player to Dewford
description: Mr. Briney, grateful for Peeko's rescue, sails the player from his cottage on Route 104 to Dewford Town (and later to Slateport).
lore: Boat travel is the game's first 'vehicle' gate before Surf.

title: Brawly and the Knuckle Badge
tagline: Second Gym: Dewford Town (Fighting)
description: Dewford Gym is a dark maze lit wider with each trainer defeated. Leader Brawly, a surfer and Fighting-type expert, awards the Knuckle Badge and TM08 Bulk Up.
lore: Knuckle Badge enables Flash outside battle.

title: The letter for Steven
tagline: Steven Stone in the depths of Granite Cave
description: The player receives HM05 Flash in Granite Cave and finds Steven Stone, a rare-stone enthusiast, in its deepest chamber. He accepts his father's letter, gives TM47 Steel Wing and registers in the PokéNav.
lore: First meeting with Steven, who later turns out to be the former Champion-level trainer guiding the player through the crisis.

title: Team Aqua at the Oceanic Museum
tagline: Archie reveals Team Aqua's goal
description: In Slateport the player delivers the Devon Goods (submarine parts) to Capt. Stern at the Oceanic Museum just as Team Aqua grunts try to seize them. Their leader Archie appears, explains Aqua wants to expand the sea for Pokémon, and withdraws.
lore: First appearance of Archie; Devon's parts are for Stern's submarine, which Aqua will later steal.

title: Rival battle on Route 110
tagline: The rival checks the player's progress and gives the Itemfinder
description: North of Slateport, below Cycling Road, the rival battles the player again and hands over the Itemfinder (Dowsing Machine).

title: Wally's first battle
tagline: Wally insists on battling to prove himself
description: In Mauville, Wally and his uncle meet the player; Wally challenges the player with his Ralts. After losing he resolves to grow stronger and moves on to Verdanturf.

title: Wattson and the Dynamo Badge
tagline: Third Gym: Mauville City (Electric)
description: Leader Wattson, Mauville's jovial city planner, awards the Dynamo Badge and TM34 Shock Wave. Rydel's Bike Shop gives the player a Mach or Acro Bike.
lore: Dynamo Badge enables Rock Smash outside battle. Wattson later sends the player to shut down New Mauville's generator.

title: Breaking through Rusturf Tunnel
tagline: Wanda's boyfriend digs through; Rock Smash and Strength open paths
description: With Rock Smash (from a Mauville resident) the player clears Rusturf Tunnel, reuniting Wanda with her boyfriend and receiving HM04 Strength.

title: The meteorite at Meteor Falls
tagline: Team Magma takes Prof. Cozmo's meteorite; Team Aqua gives chase
description: Past Fallarbor, Team Magma corners Prof. Cozmo in Meteor Falls and seizes his meteorite. Maxie explains Magma wants to expand the land, then Archie and Team Aqua arrive and Magma heads for Mt. Chimney.
lore: First appearance of Maxie. The meteorite is a power source to wake the volcano.

title: Showdown at Mt. Chimney
tagline: Stopping Maxie from erupting the volcano
description: The player rides the cable car up Mt. Chimney, where Team Aqua and Team Magma are fighting. The player defeats Admin Tabitha and Maxie, removing the meteorite from Magma's machine; Maxie retreats and the player keeps the Meteorite.
lore: First boss battle against an evil-team leader.

title: Flannery and the Heat Badge
tagline: Fourth Gym: Lavaridge Town (Fire)
description: Hot-springs town Lavaridge is home to Flannery, a new Leader who took over from her grandfather. She awards the Heat Badge and TM50 Overheat. An old woman gives a Wynaut Egg and the rival gives the Go-Goggles needed for the Route 111 desert.
lore: Heat Badge enables Strength outside battle. The Go-Goggles unlock the desert sandstorm.

title: Dad's Gym: the Balance Badge
tagline: Fifth Gym: Petalburg City (Normal) against Dad
description: With four badges the player challenges Norman. Winning the Balance Badge and TM42 Facade, the player then receives HM03 Surf from Wally's father, opening the sea routes.
lore: Balance Badge enables Surf outside battle — the biggest map unlock of the game.

title: Team Aqua seizes the Weather Institute
tagline: Aqua wants research on the weather Pokémon
description: On Route 119 Team Aqua occupies the Weather Institute to steal research about the legendary Pokémon that controls rain. The player defeats Admin Shelly and receives a Castform as thanks.
lore: Foreshadows Kyogre.

title: Rival battle and HM Fly
tagline: The rival gives HM02 Fly after their fourth battle
description: Outside the Weather Institute the rival battles the player and then gives HM02 Fly.
lore: Fly requires the Feather Badge to use outside battle.

title: The invisible obstacle and the Devon Scope
tagline: Steven reveals the hidden Kecleon
description: An invisible Pokémon blocks the way out of Fortree. On Route 120 Steven gives the player the Devon Scope, which reveals Kecleon; once cleared, the path to the Fortree Gym and beyond opens.

title: Winona and the Feather Badge
tagline: Sixth Gym: Fortree City (Flying)
description: In the treetop city of Fortree, Leader Winona awards the Feather Badge and TM40 Aerial Ace.
lore: Feather Badge enables Fly outside battle.

title: Last rival battle in Lilycove
tagline: The rival's final regular battle
description: In Lilycove City the rival battles the player one last time, then returns home to help Prof. Birch.

title: The orbs of Mt. Pyre
tagline: Archie and Maxie steal the Red and Blue Orbs
description: At the summit of Mt. Pyre, Team Aqua and Team Magma steal the Red Orb and Blue Orb from the elderly couple who guard them. The old woman gives the player the Magma Emblem so they can follow Team Magma.
lore: The orbs control Groudon and Kyogre. The Magma Emblem unlocks the Magma Hideout entrance on Jagged Pass.

title: Groudon awakens in the Magma Hideout
tagline: Maxie uses the Blue Orb on Groudon
description: Inside Mt. Chimney's Magma Hideout, the player fights through grunts and Tabitha but arrives as Maxie awakens Groudon, which vanishes from the lair.

title: Team Aqua steals the submarine
tagline: Infiltrating the Aqua Hideout in Lilycove
description: The player surfs into Team Aqua's base in Lilycove and defeats Admin Matt, but Archie escapes in Capt. Stern's stolen submarine toward the Seafloor Cavern. The player finds a Master Ball in the hideout.

title: Tate & Liza and the Mind Badge
tagline: Seventh Gym: Mossdeep City (Psychic, double battle)
description: The twin Leaders Tate and Liza battle together in a double battle and award the Mind Badge and TM04 Calm Mind.
lore: Mind Badge enables Dive outside battle.

title: Team Magma attacks the Space Center
tagline: A double battle at Steven's side
description: Team Magma storms the Mossdeep Space Center to steal rocket fuel for Mt. Chimney. The player and Steven defeat Maxie and Tabitha in a multi battle. Steven then gives HM08 Dive from his house.

title: Kyogre awakens in the Seafloor Cavern
tagline: Archie uses the Red Orb
description: Diving on Route 128 the player finds the stolen submarine and Seafloor Cavern. After defeating Shelly and Archie, Archie awakens Kyogre with the Red Orb, which escapes and causes torrential rain across Hoenn, while Groudon causes drought.
lore: Maxie arrives and both leaders realise they have lost control.

title: Groudon and Kyogre clash in Sootopolis
tagline: The two titans fight inside the crater city
description: In Sootopolis, Groudon and Kyogre battle in the city's crater lake. Steven guides the player to the Cave of Origin where Wallace explains that only the legendary Pokémon of the sky can stop them.

title: Awakening Rayquaza at Sky Pillar
tagline: Rayquaza descends and calms the titans
description: The player climbs Sky Pillar (Mach Bike needed for the cracked floors) and wakes Rayquaza, which flies to Sootopolis and ends the fight. Archie and Maxie admit their mistakes and leave.

title: Juan and the Rain Badge
tagline: Eighth Gym: Sootopolis City (Water)
description: With peace restored, the Sootopolis Gym reopens. Leader Juan, Wallace's mentor, awards the Rain Badge and TM03 Water Pulse; Wallace gives HM07 Waterfall.
lore: Rain Badge enables Waterfall outside battle, the gate to Victory Road.

title: Wally at Victory Road
tagline: Wally has become a real Trainer
description: At Victory Road Wally, now healthy and strong with Gardevoir, challenges the player one final time before the League.

title: The Elite Four
tagline: Sidney, Phoebe, Glacia and Drake
description: At the Pokémon League in Ever Grande City the player defeats the Elite Four in sequence: Sidney (Dark), Phoebe (Ghost), Glacia (Ice) and Drake (Dragon).

title: Champion Wallace and the Hall of Fame
tagline: The player becomes Champion
description: The player defeats Champion Wallace. Prof. Birch and the rival arrive to congratulate the player, and the team is entered into the Hall of Fame. Credits roll.
lore: End of the main story.

title: The S.S. Ticket and the roaming Eon Pokémon
tagline: Back home, TV reports a roaming Pokémon
description: After the credits the player wakes up at home. A TV report about a mysterious red/blue Pokémon sets Latias or Latios roaming Hoenn. Dad gives the S.S. Ticket, unlocking the S.S. Tidal between Slateport and Lilycove and the Battle Frontier.

title: Scott and the Battle Frontier
tagline: Scott reveals his Battle Frontier
description: Scott, who has been scouting the player since Rustboro, invites them to the Battle Frontier. Seven facilities each have a Frontier Brain (Anabel, Tucker, Spenser, Greta, Noland, Lucy, Brandon) who awards Silver and Gold Symbols.

title: Steven's challenge in Meteor Falls
tagline: The strongest trainer waits in a hidden cave
description: Using Waterfall in Meteor Falls the player reaches Steven's cave and can battle him at full strength.

title: The Sealed Chamber and the Regis
tagline: Braille puzzles unlock three ancient golems
description: Braille in the Sealed Chamber (Route 134, reached with Dive) instructs the player to have Wailord and Relicanth in the party; doing so opens three tombs: Desert Ruins (Regirock), Island Cave (Regice) and Ancient Tomb (Registeel).

title: Kyogre, Groudon and Rayquaza return
tagline: Weather reports lead to Marine Cave and Terra Cave
description: After becoming Champion, the Weather Institute reports abnormal weather pointing to Marine Cave (Kyogre) or Terra Cave (Groudon) appearing on certain routes; Rayquaza can be battled at the top of Sky Pillar.

title: National Pokédex upgrade
tagline: Birch upgrades the Pokédex and offers a Johto starter
description: With the Hoenn Pokédex complete, Prof. Birch upgrades it to the National Pokédex and offers Chikorita, Cyndaquil or Totodile.

title: Event islands
tagline: Distribution tickets open Southern Island, Faraway Island, Navel Rock and Birth Island
description: Event-only key items (Eon Ticket, Old Sea Map, Mystic Ticket, Aurora Ticket) shown at Lilycove Harbor take the player to islands with Latias/Latios, Mew, Lugia and Ho-Oh, and Deoxys.
lore: Mystery Gift content; the islands exist in the ROM but are unreachable without the event items.
